foundation: Barrot V3 execution, orchestration, safety and verification

receipt_contract.digest_scope: Hashes cover exact normalized excerpt strings stored in this artifact, not original HTML, exchange wire bytes, HTTP headers, TLS metadata or transport-cache metadata.
receipt_contract.timestamp_policy: Page update timestamps are not exchange event timestamps. Do not treat them as synchronized market-event times.

method.sampling: Full visible order book sampled each minute
method.venue_combination: Spot and perpetual books are summed; their prices may differ slightly.

sources.normalized_excerpt: Edge or Not XRP liquidity heatmap updated 2026-11-07T09:19:00Z: XRP mid 1.1717; visible bids within 1% $9.8M; asks within 1% $10.4M. Largest ask levels: 1.1752 $1.3M, 1.1740 $2.6M, 1.1728 $2.3M. Largest bid levels: 1.1705 $1.5M, 1.1693 $2.6M, 1.1670 $1.6M. Method: Binance spot and OKX XRP-USDT perpetual, full visible depth sampled each minute, averaged into 15-minute buckets, converted to USD; only within +/-1.5% of price. Other venues, hidden/iceberg size and orders outside range excluded. Orders can be pulled. The publisher says this order-book signal is not tested and history starts 2026-10-21.
limitations: Only Binance spot and OKX XRP-USDT perpetual are included; this is not consolidated market depth.
Hidden and iceberg liquidity, other venues and orders outside the +/-1.5% price window are excluded.
Displayed orders can be cancelled or pulled; a visible wall is not committed support or resistance.
The publisher explicitly says its order-book signal has not been tested; history begins 2026-10-21.
The page timestamp is a publisher update time, not a per-order exchange event timestamp.

derived_reconciliation.interpretation: The 0.33285% price-reference difference is not an arbitrage spread. Page update times differ by 13 minutes, instruments and venue universes differ, and no synchronized USD/USDT normalization or executable multi-venue depth is available. The two aggregators are separate publishers but their underlying exchange coverage may overlap; source independence is not established at the venue-observation level.
